## Edit

### Reference-driven AI editing
<a id="ai-reference-driven-edit"></a>

Give Claude the reel whose style you like, then your raw footage path; it edits in that style with no timeline editor; then give feedback in plain words.

> I like the style of this reel. Can we duplicate this style and use it for a video of mine?

### Seven-repo editing stack
<a id="ai-seven-tool-stack"></a>

FFmpeg (every cut, mix, render), faster-whisper (word timing), Whisper, yt-dlp (download sources), OpenCV + contrib CSRT tracker (follow the speaker in a 9:16 crop), Puppeteer (render HTML captions), HyperFrames (agent-built motion graphics).

## Sound

### AI sound stack: Real SFX + earshot
<a id="ai-real-sfx-placement"></a>

AI editors can't hear. Real SFX places a real recording on each moment, ducks it under voice and outputs MP4 + WAV + report (only 78 UI sounds, so pair it with a library); earshot critiques the mix and sync and makes whooshes in code.

> Honest limit: it ships only 78 UI sounds, which is why you pair it with a library.
